name: Finnmark FD-4 Trinity 2-Person Hybrid Infrared & Steam Sauna & Red Light
description: Description Why choose between infrared and traditional when you can have it all? The Finnmark Trinity is the ultimate home sauna, a revolutionary 3-in-1 wellness sanctuary designed to end compromise. It seamlessly combines deep-penetrating infrared heat, classic Finnish steam, and red light therapy into one luxurious cabin. The Trinity is engineered to fit any modern home. In infrared and red light mode it runs from a standard 120V outlet — power on and use. For the full traditional sauna experience, the included Harvia Vega heater draws more current and needs a dedicated 20-amp circuit (your electrician can typically install this in an hour) — a small one-time setup for a lifetime of authentic Finnish steam. Three Saunas in One: The Trinity Experience Depending on your mood and wellness goals, you can choose your perfect session. Here’s what each mode feels like: For Deep, Penetrating Warmth (Infrared): Engage the UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters. This is a dry, deeply penetrating heat that feels warming and relaxing. It's an intense, productive sweat at a comfortable air temperature, reaching up to 170°F. For a Classic, Powerful Sweat (Traditional): Power on the legendary Harvia Vega traditional heater. Ladle water over the hot stones to create a wave of invigorating steam, or "löyly." This is the classic, high-heat (up to 190°F) Finnish sauna experience that’s perfect for a powerful sense of release. For a Calming Finish (Red Light): Bathe in the glow of the Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy panel. Its 650nm red light creates a calming end to any session. Features & Construction The Trinity is built with premium materials to support a lifetime of wellness. Electrical Details: 120V single-phase. The infrared heaters and red light panel operate on a standard 15-amp circuit (NEMA 5-15P plug). The Harvia Vega traditional heater requires a dedicated 20-amp circuit — the install manual specifies a licensed electrician must complete this connection. Both circuits can share the same 120V outlet location. Antimicrobial Canadian Cedar Interior: The beautiful cedar interior naturally resists mold and bacteria, keeping your sanctuary fresh while providing that classic sauna aroma. Durable Thermal-Treated Exterior: The Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior is chemically-free and treated to resist warping, rot, or chipping for decades of durability. Intuitive Controls & Premium Sound: A sleek, built-in LCD touchscreen with Bluetooth lets you control your entire experience, while 6" HiFi marine-grade speakers deliver crystal-clear audio. Spacious Two-Tier Bench System: The extra-large, multi-level bench provides ample room for multiple people or allows you to sit higher in the heat. What's Included Everything you need to set up your ultimate sauna arrives at your door: Sauna Wall, Floor & Ceiling Panels Pre-Hung 8mm Tempered Glass Door Two-Tier Bench System (6) Spectrum Plus™ Infrared Heater Panels (1) Harvia Vega Compact 1900 Traditional Heater (1) 29lb Box of Premium Harvia Sauna Stones (1) Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy Panel with 650nm plus color lighting LCD Touchscreen Controller & Bluetooth Audio System Comprehensive Warranty & ETL Certification Specifications Model FD-4 External Materials Thermo-Aspen Interior Materials Western Red Cedar Volts 120 IR Watts 1750 Amperage 15/20 Plug Type NEMA 5-15P Outlet 120V — 15A circuit for IR/red light; dedicated 20A circuit required for traditional heater (electrician install) Maximum Temperature IR 170F - Traditional 190F Interior Dimensions 44.25"W x 45.5"D x 75.5"H Exterior Dimensions 48"W x 48"D x 83"H Room Volume 86 cu. ft. Door Dimensions 23.625"W x 68.875"H Door Handle Dimensions 1.5"W x 13.25"H Glass Thickness 8mm W/Gasket Product Weight 437 lbs Shipping Dimensions 36"W x 80"D Shipping Weight 485 lbs W/48 lb Pallet Assembly & Operating Cost Even for this advanced sauna, the process is incredibly simple. Assembly: The panels are designed to latch together easily. Grab a friend (it's a two-person job to be safe) and a screwdriver for the door handle. You’ll have it set up in about 90-120 minutes. Electrical: If your existing outlet is a standard 15A circuit, you can use IR and red light mode immediately. For traditional steam, schedule an electrician to install the dedicated 20A circuit before first use of the Harvia heater. Typical cost: $150–400 depending on your panel. Operating Cost: The cost per session is remarkably low. Infrared Mode: ~20 to 30 cents per hour. Traditional Mode: ~25 to 35 cents per hour. Owner's Manual: You can view the complete owner's manual here: Download Owner's Manual .
